navikt/dinesykmeldte, UNMODIFIED, at a pinned ref. Next.js 16.2.9 App Router, React, vitest. Verified baseline: 50 files, 318 tests, ~10s under Node 24.

This target needs a GitHub Packages token: seven of its fourteen @navikt dependencies are private. The repo's own .npmrc reads it from NPM_AUTH_TOKEN, so that variable must be exported before install. Nothing here is stubbed or stripped, which was the earlier plan and is no longer necessary.

The app logs errors during its own tests (network and JWT lines). Those are the application's logging, not failures; the suite is green.
